  2. Created src/core/context/strategies/BudgetedPruningStrategy.ts implementing CompactionStrategy:
     - Resolves a token budget: options.tokenBudget > class override > 0.6 * contextWindowLimit.
     - Partitions pinned vs unpinned using the same stable content-based ID scheme as PinningStrategy (never prunes pinned messages).
     - Scores unpinned messages via SemanticAnalyzer.scoreImportance; sorts ascending by importance with original-index (oldest-first) tiebreak; greedily keeps messages until estimated tokens fit the budget (pinned tokens subtracted first).
     - Returns CompactionResult preserving original conversation order, with pruned list, token deltas, and an informative summary.
  3.   4. Used relative imports (../CompactionStrategy.js, ../SemanticAnalyzer.js) to avoid circular dependencies.

  - Pinned messages are protected via the same stable-ID matching used by PinningStrategy, so pins survive budgeted pruning.
  - Token estimation uses TokenTracker.estimateTokens (cached) and estimateTokensCached for before/after deltas, consistent with other strategies.
